limits: Operator-reported display readings are not synchronized power samples, time averages or peak capture.
Temperatures are on-chip sensors, not ambient; no thermal equilibrium claim.
Relocation and display-mode changes before P3 limit direct comparisons between P0–P2 and P3–P5.
DSP and frame rates use logged statistics after the first minute and before the last telemetry sample; they do not establish hardware maximum throughput.
Firmware 1.0.2 is the tested installation; results do not establish performance of Resource Center V1.0.0.
P6/P7 use synthetic varied inputs for model 8000 on C7x_1 and 7x7 convolution on C7x_2; P7 camera frames are processed separately from inference.
High DSP busy-time does not establish maximum MMA arithmetic throughput or absolute board maximum power.
